from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from openpyxl import load_workbook
import re, math

base=Path('inputs')
files=sorted((base/'CHIP_DP10_GQ20_PASS').glob('*.xlsx'))
print('sample files',len(files))
# status rows
wb=load_workbook(base/'230215_Trio_Status.xlsx',read_only=True,data_only=True)
ws=wb.active
status={}
for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2,values_only=True):
    sid=row[0]
    if sid is None: continue
    sid=str(sid).strip()
    status[sid]=row
carriers={sid for sid,row in status.items() if str(row[3]).strip()=='Carrier'}
print('carrier IDs',len(carriers),sorted(carriers,key=lambda x:(not x.isdigit(),int(x) if x.isdigit() else x)))

allstats=Counter(); byfile={}; carrier_files=[]; missing=[]
for path in files:
    sid=path.stem.split('_CHIP_',1)[1]
    # workbook parse full dimensions
    wb=load_workbook(path,read_only=True,data_only=True)
    ws=wb.active; ws.reset_dimensions()
    rows=ws.iter_rows(values_only=True)
    top=next(rows); hdr=next(rows)
    h={str(v).strip():i for i,v in enumerate(hdr) if v is not None}
    needed=['Zygosity','Variant Allele Freq','Gene Names','Sequence Ontology (Combined)','Classification','In_CHIP','Ref/Alt','Chr:Pos']
    if any(x not in h for x in needed): print('missing headers',path,[x for x in needed if x not in h])
    counts=Counter(); so=Counter(); classif=Counter(); chipvals=Counter(); zyg=Counter(); vafs=[]
    n=0
    for row in rows:
        n+=1
        vals={k: row[i] if i<len(row) else None for k,i in h.items()}
        chipvals[str(vals['In_CHIP'])]+=1
        zyg[str(vals['Zygosity'])]+=1
        so[str(vals['Sequence Ontology (Combined)'])]+=1
        classif[str(vals['Classification'])]+=1
        v=vals['Variant Allele Freq']
        if v is not None:
            try: vafs.append(float(v))
            except: pass
    counts['rows']=n
    byfile[sid]=(counts,chipvals,zyg,so,classif,vafs,top,hdr)
    allstats['rows']+=n
    if sid in carriers:
        carrier_files.append(sid)
    # print summary
print('all rows',allstats['rows'],'carrier files',len(carrier_files),sorted(carrier_files))
print('carriers missing files',sorted(carriers-set(carrier_files)))
print('status IDs missing from files',sorted(set(status)-{path.stem.split('_CHIP_',1)[1] for path in files}))
print('all In_CHIP values',Counter({k:sum(v[1][k] for v in byfile.values()) for k in set().union(*(set(v[1]) for v in byfile.values()))}))
print('all zygosity',Counter({k:sum(v[2][k] for v in byfile.values()) for k in set().union(*(set(v[2]) for v in byfile.values()))}))
print('all sequence ontology (top)')
for k,n in Counter({k:sum(v[3][k] for v in byfile.values()) for k in set().union(*(set(v[3]) for v in byfile.values()))}).most_common(): print(repr(k),n)
print('all classification (top)')
for k,n in Counter({k:sum(v[4][k] for v in byfile.values()) for k in set().union(*(set(v[4]) for v in byfile.values()) )}).most_common(): print(repr(k),n)

from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from openpyxl import load_workbook
import re, math
base=Path('inputs')
# status
wb=load_workbook(base/'230215_Trio_Status.xlsx',read_only=True,data_only=True); ws=wb.active
status={str(row[0]).strip():row for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2,values_only=True) if row[0] is not None}
carriers={sid for sid,row in status.items() if str(row[3]).strip()=='Carrier'}

def file_id(path):
    tail=path.stem.split('_CHIP_',1)[1]
    if tail.split('-',1)[0].isdigit(): return tail.split('-',1)[0]
    return tail

files=sorted((base/'CHIP_DP10_GQ20_PASS').glob('*.xlsx'))
carrier_paths=[p for p in files if file_id(p) in carriers]
print('carrier paths',len(carrier_paths),[(file_id(p),p.name) for p in carrier_paths])
print('missing carrier IDs',sorted(carriers-{file_id(p) for p in files}))

# helper row dict
def getrows(path):
  wb=load_workbook(path,read_only=True,data_only=True); ws=wb.active; ws.reset_dimensions()
  it=ws.iter_rows(values_only=True); top=next(it); hdr=next(it)
  h={str(x).strip():i for i,x in enumerate(hdr) if x is not None}
  for rn,row in enumerate(it,start=3):
    yield rn,{k:(row[i] if i<len(row) else None) for k,i in h.items()}

allc=Counter(); soc=Counter(); classc=Counter(); zc=Counter(); examples=defaultdict(list)
for p in carrier_paths:
  for rn,r in getrows(p):
    allc['rows']+=1
    z=str(r['Zygosity']) if r['Zygosity'] is not None else None
    zc[z]+=1
    v=r['Variant Allele Freq']
    try: vf=float(v)
    except: vf=None
    if vf is not None and vf<0.3:
      allc['vaf_lt_0.3']+=1
      if z "'!= '"'Reference':
        allc['vaf_lt_ref_excluded']+=1
        so=str(r['Sequence Ontology (Combined)']) if r['Sequence Ontology (Combined)']] is not None else None
        # identify regions with keywords
        low=so.lower() if so else ''
        exclude=any(x in low for x in ['intron','intergenic','utr'])
        if exclude: allc['region_excluded']+=1
        else:
          allc['region_kept']+=1
          cl=r['Classification']
          if cl is not None and str(cl).strip()"'!='"'': allc['classification_present']+=1
          if cl in ('Benign','Likely Benign'): allc['benign_lb']+=1
          soc[so]+=1; classc[str(cl) if cl is not None else None]+=1
          if len(examples[(z,so,cl)])<3: examples[(z,so,cl)].append((p.name,rn,r['Chr:Pos'],r['Ref/Alt'],r['Gene Names'],v))
print('\\naggregate stage',allc)
print('zyg',zc)
print('kept SO',soc)
print('kept classifications',classc)
print('\\nexamples None zygosity')
n=0
for p in carrier_paths:
  for rn,r in getrows(p):
    if r['Zygosity'] is None and n<20:
      print(p.name,rn,{k:r[k] for k in ['Chr:Pos','Ref/Alt','Zygosity','Variant Allele Freq','Gene Names','Sequence Ontology (Combined)','Classification','In_CHIP']})
      n+=1
print('none examples total shown',n)

from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
from openpyxl import load_workbook

base = Path('inputs')
status_path = base / '230215_Trio_Status.xlsx'
genes_path = base / '230214_Schenz_et_al_2022_CHIP_Genes.xlsx'
variant_dir = base / 'CHIP_DP10_GQ20_PASS'

# CHIP gene scope from supplied gene list.
wb = load_workbook(genes_path, read_only=True, data_only=True)
ws = wb.active
chip_genes = {str(row[0]).strip().upper() for row in ws.iter_rows(values_only=True) if row[0] is not None}

# Carrier sample IDs from supplied status table.
wb = load_workbook(status_path, read_only=True, data_only=True)
ws = wb.active
carrier_ids = {
    str(row[0]).strip()
    for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, values_only=True)
    if row[0] is not None and str(row[3]).strip() == 'Carrier'
}

def sample_id(path):
    tail = path.stem.split('_CHIP_', 1)[1]
    prefix = tail.split('-', 1)[0]
    return prefix if prefix.isdigit() else tail

def cell(row, index):
    return row[index] if index < len(row) else None

def overlaps_chip(gene_field):
    if gene_field is None:
        return False
    return any(token.strip().upper() in chip_genes for token in str(gene_field).split(','))

counts = Counter()
classified_labels = Counter()
carrier_files = 0
for path in sorted(variant_dir.glob('*.xlsx')):
    if sample_id(path) not in carrier_ids:
        continue
    carrier_files += 1
    wb = load_workbook(path, read_only=True, data_only=True)
    ws = wb.active
    # Supplied sheets have an incorrect A1 dimension; reset it to scan all XML rows.
    ws.reset_dimensions()
    rows = ws.iter_rows(values_only=True)
    next(rows)  # grouped title row
    header = next(rows)
    idx = {str(value).strip(): i for i, value in enumerate(header) if value is not None}
    required = {'Gene Names', 'Variant Allele Freq', 'Zygosity', 'Sequence Ontology (Combined)', 'Classification'}
    missing = required - idx.keys()
    if missing:
        raise RuntimeError(f'{path.name}: missing {sorted(missing)}')
    for row in rows:
        if not overlaps_chip(cell(row, idx['Gene Names'])):
            continue
        counts['chip_rows'] += 1
        try:
            vaf = float(cell(row, idx['Variant Allele Freq']))
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            continue
        if not vaf < 0.3:
            continue
        counts['vaf_lt_0_3'] += 1
        if str(cell(row, idx['Zygosity'])).strip() == 'Reference':
            continue
        counts['nonreference'] += 1
        so = str(cell(row, idx['Sequence Ontology (Combined)']) or '').lower()
        if any(term in so for term in ('intron', 'intergenic', 'utr')):
            continue
        counts['region_filtered'] += 1
        classification = cell(row, idx['Classification'])
        if classification is None or str(classification).strip() == '':
            continue
        counts['clinvar_classified'] += 1
        classified_labels[str(classification).strip()] += 1
        if str(classification).strip() in {'Benign', 'Likely Benign'}:
            counts['benign_or_likely_benign'] += 1

num = counts['benign_or_likely_benign']
den = counts['clinvar_classified']
if den == 0:
    raise RuntimeError('No classified variants in denominator')
proportion = num / den
print('carrier IDs:', len(carrier_ids))
print('carrier files:', carrier_files)
print('missing files:', sorted(carrier_ids - {sample_id(p) for p in variant_dir.glob('*.xlsx')}))
print('counts:', dict(counts))
print('classified labels:', dict(classified_labels))
print('proportion:', f'{proportion:.17g}')
assert (num, den) == (37, 37)
assert proportion == 1.0
PY"
